name: Dead Acre
summary: In southeastern Westfall, Dead Acre lies burned and abandoned near the bridge to Duskwood. The Defias Brotherhood torched the farm during its uprising, and rogue harvest golems still stalk the blackened fields.

sections.title: Ashes on the Border
sections.body: North of the road from Sentinel Hill to Duskwood, Dead Acre stands among Westfall’s old breadbasket farms. The homestead once gave good harvests, until the Defias Brotherhood rose in revolt and drove out the landowners. Then farm and crops went up in flames. Scorched timber and smoking earth remain, while mechanical Harvest Watchers still reap the barren soil.

faq.q: Why is this place called the Dead Acre?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood burned the farmstead and fields when they took control of Westfall. Blackened ruins and smoldering earth gave the farm its grim name.

faq.q: Why are mechanical Harvest Watchers wandering here?
faq.answer: Mechanical reapers once tended Westfall’s crops, but settlers fled or died and left them behind. Without caretakers, or corrupted, the Harvest Watchers still patrol the burned fields and attack anyone who comes near.

faq.q: Where is the Dead Acre located?
faq.answer: Dead Acre lies in southeastern Westfall, just north of the main road near the bridge into Duskwood.

angles.text: Dead Acre recalls Stormwind’s neglect of Westfall, which left loyal farmers defenseless against the Defias Brotherhood’s violence.
